title: Put Not Your Trust in Princes

questions.question: Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord, O my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:1 (ESV): "Praise the Lord! Praise the Lord, O my soul!"

questions.question: I will praise the Lord as long as I live; I will sing praises to my God while I have my what?
Put not your trust in princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:3 (ESV): "in whom there is no salvation."

questions.question: When his breath departs, he returns to the earth; on that very day his plans do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:4 (ESV): "on that very day his plans perish."

questions.question: Blessed is he whose help is the God of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:5 (ESV): "Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob,"

questions.question: Whose hope is in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:5 (ESV): "whose hope is in the Lord his God,"

questions.question: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, who keeps faith how long?
Who executes justice for the oppressed, who gives food to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:7 (ESV): "who gives food to the hungry."

questions.question: The Lord sets the prisoners what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:7 (ESV): "The Lord sets the prisoners free;"

questions.question: The Lord opens the eyes of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:8 (ESV): "The Lord opens the eyes of the blind."

questions.question: The Lord lifts up those who are bowed down; the Lord loves the what?
The Lord watches over the sojourners; he upholds the widow and the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:9 (ESV): "he upholds the widow and the fatherless,"

questions.question: But the way of the wicked he brings to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:9 (ESV): "but the way of the wicked he brings to ruin."

questions.question: The Lord will reign forever, your God, O Zion, to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 146:10 (ESV): "to all generations. Praise the Lord!"

questions.question: Psalm 146 is the first of the final five Psalms known as what?
questions.explanation: They all begin and end with "Praise the Lord" (Hallelujah).

key_verse_text: Put not your trust in princes, in a son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
